name: The Witch in the Forest
source:
The Witch in the Forest (TWITF) is a short girls love visual novel centered around Fidelia, a somewhat introverted and socially awkward young woman who stumbles upon another woman's house in the forest and befriends her. This slice of life story follows them learning more about each other while preparing for their favorite holiday- Halloween!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419740/The_Witch_in_the_Forest/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《森林中的女巫》（TWITF）是一部女孩喜爱的视觉小说，以菲黛莉亚为中心，菲黛莉亚是一位有点内向且不善社交的年轻女子，她偶然发现了森林里另一个女人的房子并与她成为了朋友。这段生活故事讲述了他们在为自己最喜欢的节日——万圣节做准备的同时，更多地了解彼此！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1419740/The_Witch_in_the_Forest/]Steam[/url]]
